_help: Defines what a note spec may contain. 'required' fields must be present, 'optional' may be omitted. To add a block type: add it here AND add a renderer in scripts/build.py (RENDERERS).

notes.date: Omit or 'auto' for today's date, or any text
notes.references: List of keys from library/sources.json, printed as a References box at the end

circuit.notes: Give exactly one of 'snippet' (id from library/circuits.json, optional 'params') or 'custom' (raw circuitikz body). 'scale' adjusts diagram sizing (e.g. 0.85).
